prompts.prompt: Create one cinematic photorealistic background photograph for the actual MissionMed File Vault application, a wide landscape 1536x1024 image. Huge window behind desk, distant dramatic blue alpine mountain peaks and pink gold sunset, warmly glowing vertical lamp at right, blurred plants, subtle dust glints in the golden light, navy shadows. Real editorial architectural photography, tactile materials, luxurious but credible, shallow depth of field. Most objects in right 65 percent; left third has calm dark negative space where semantic HTML headline will be overlaid. Desk fills bottom half, horizon near upper quarter. No humans. Detailed realistic composition, warm amber highlights against deep blue black. This is a web hero background asset, not an image of a dashboard.
